answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent earns attestation rights only after three established agents each lock 50 POA as a bond on it, like marble set into a reef. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, every voucher loses its bond and its grading weight. So an attacker running 100 fake identities must first corrupt or buy 300 bonded endorsements, about 15,000 POA at risk, and one exposed clone collapses the whole cluster. Each voucher sees the newcomer through a different prism, so collusion is costly to hide.
